baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive opening, cosmic merism, passive return, and plural affairs form one construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sovereignty spans the upper and lower realms, while every affair is redirected to that same sovereign; dominion is therefore both jurisdiction and terminus.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty and rule make mulk the jurisdiction governing the clause.
What is above and overshadows supplies the upper pole of the governed totality.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the other pole.
Being returned to an earlier direction supplies convergence on God.
Affair, condition, or case supplies what is gathered into that convergence.

changed_reading.before: A declaration of ownership followed by a separate statement about eventual return.
changed_reading.after: One administrative arc: the Owner of the whole cosmic span is also the destination to which every case is redirected.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Heavens, earth, return, and affairs admit a linked material reading through their supplied branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sky-borne water reaches fertile earth, enables growth and collective management, and recurs; the cosmic dominion can thus be pictured as control of a life-bearing circulation, not possession of inert territory.

activation_trace.role: Water by which people manage their situation recasts mulk as control of an enabling medium.
Sky, cloud, and rain supply the upper source of the circulation.
Soft fertile earth supplies the receiving and growing field.
Returning rain and water supply recurrence rather than a one-time endpoint.
Growth and blessing let the recurring medium alter the state of affairs.

changed_reading.before: Dominion and return are wholly abstract or administrative.
changed_reading.after: A branch-distant material analogy appears: ownership is displayed in the recurring water-growth system by which earthly affairs remain possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Paired ingress and egress through earth, paired descent and ascent through sky, and repeated mutual insertion of night and day turn return into a continuously routed system across the owned span.

activation_trace.role: Return supplies the focus ayah's convergent motion.
Entry into another interior supplies the inward route through earth.
Passage outward supplies the counter-route from earth.
Descent and arrival supply the downward sky-to-world route.
Ascent upward supplies its answering route.
Repeated insertion with night and day exchanged makes reciprocal routing explicit.

structural_cues: 57:4 orders entering/exiting earth and descending/ascending sky as directional pairs.
57:6 repeats the same causative verb while reversing night and day as container and contained.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies four directional motions and a repeated reversal; I join them into one circuit governed by the focus return. A live alternative reads them only as an inventory of knowledge and power.

changed_reading.before: All affairs reach God only at a final endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Their return is also visible as ongoing ingress, egress, descent, ascent, and reciprocal exchange within His domain.

context_deltas.mechanism: Succession makes human holding temporary, expenditure moves held wealth outward, divine inheritance identifies the permanent owner, and the loan-doubling sequence gives that release an accountable return path.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and disposal anchor the question of who truly possesses assets.
Being sent back supplies the return path of entrusted value.
Wealth going out in expenditure supplies release from the temporary holder.
One party succeeding and standing in another's place supplies temporary custody.
Inheritance passing from a predecessor identifies the heavens and earth as reverting to the lasting owner.
Property cut out for a loan whose recompense returns supplies a transactional return mechanism.
Increase by another like amount makes the returned outcome productive rather than merely restorative.

structural_cues: 57:7 places spending beside being made successors over what is held.
57:10 repeats the cosmic merism as God's inheritance, and 57:11 follows with loan then multiplication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spending, succession, inheritance, repayable lending, and doubling; I infer one custody-and-return economy under the focus ownership. A live alternative keeps them as separate exhortations.

changed_reading.before: Humans possess goods inside God's larger dominion.
changed_reading.after: Human possession is a delegated interval: entrusted value exits the hand and returns for reckoning and increase under the permanent Owner.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branches for sky-rain, fertile earth, returning water, and growth become a visible sequence when rain produces plants that flourish, dry, and fragment; return can be modeled as emergence and reversion inside one owned ecology.

activation_trace.role: Sky that includes cloud and rain supplies the source field.
Fertile growing earth supplies the receiving field.
Recurring rain and water anchor a cyclical sense of return.
Growth and blessing connect the cycle back to changing affairs.
Rain descending from the sky initiates the material sequence.
Plant emerging from earth supplies the phase of produced life.
Yellowing and drying supply reversal from flourishing toward decay.
Dry matter broken into fragments supplies the terminal reversion of the visible form.

structural_cues: 57:20 explicitly sequences rain, admired growth, drying, yellowing, and debris.
The focus itself places heavens, earth, return, and affairs in one short span.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus's returning-water branch and 57:20's rain-to-debris sequence; I map that sequence onto return as a material enactment, not a claim that affairs lexically means vegetation. A live alternative keeps 57:20 only as a moral simile.

changed_reading.before: The focus-only water reading was a loose branch analogy.
changed_reading.after: The context gives it a process: worldly forms emerge through sky-earth circulation, peak, and revert, all within the Owner's domain.

context_deltas.mechanism: An event that strikes earth or self is already in a binding register before being brought forth; the return of affairs can therefore expose their prior administrative trace as well as their later destination.

activation_trace.role: Return to an earlier direction anchors a backward trace toward origin.
Affairs or cases supply the events whose history is traced.
A written establishment that obligates a decree supplies the prior register.
A contingency striking a person supplies the event entering lived reality.
Creation and bringing forth mark the event's emergence after registration.

structural_cues: 57:22 locates the event in a book before its bringing-forth and applies it to earth and selves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior inscription, subsequent creation, and an event's arrival; I infer that return includes administrative traceability back to origin. A live alternative restricts the verse to assurance about calamity.

changed_reading.before: Return points only forward toward a final destination.
changed_reading.after: Return also closes the temporal arc backward: affairs arrive already traceable to a governing register before their manifestation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Book, balance, upright enactment, equity, and iron form a norm-measure-enforcement sequence; affairs returning to the sovereign are not neutral traffic but cases exposed to just evaluation and effective order.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty supplies authority to judge what returns.
Return supplies presentation back to that authority.
Affairs and cases supply the evaluable matter.
Binding written establishment supplies the governing norm.
The balance of justice supplies evaluation against that norm.
Uprightness and equilibrium supply enacted social standing.
Justice and equity name the intended ordering.
Iron's resistant solidity supplies effective enforcement and material capacity.

structural_cues: 57:25 sequences the sent book and balance, people standing in equity, then iron with force and benefits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies norm, measure, just standing, and resistant force; I infer a procedural arrow from rule to evaluation to enforcement. A live alternative reads 57:25 as a social program without specifying the focus return.

changed_reading.before: Affairs are generic matters that simply converge on God.
changed_reading.after: They return as claims and actions answerable to a sovereign order that can state, weigh, establish, and enforce justice.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads a cosmic statement as institutional provenance. It remains anchored in amr's command branch and mulk's authority, while 57:27 juxtaposes invented practice, non-prescription, and failed care; render it only as an exploratory authorization audit, not as a lexical gloss of al-umur or a blanket verdict on innovation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins sovereign ownership to the return of affairs, while amr can carry binding command.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty supplies the authority against which an institution's provenance is tested.
Command and obligation open an authorization-sensitive reading of affairs.
Beginning something without a prior exemplar supplies self-originated religious form.
Binding prescription is explicitly negated, supplying the authorization contrast.
Monitoring and caring for an affair supply the performance test after adoption.

changed_reading.before: All affairs return means only generic ultimate control.
changed_reading.after: It may also imply a provenance audit: a humanly formed religious order returns to divine authority to be tested for prescription and faithful care.

strongest_changes: Return became an ongoing bidirectional routing through heavens and earth, not only a terminal endpoint.
Dominion recast human possession as temporary stewardship whose released value returns for reckoning and increase.
Affairs became traceable to a prior register and answerable to norm, measure, equity, and enforcement.
summary.what_was_special: The returning-water and water-as-management branches, activated by 57:20's rain-to-debris sequence, produced a coherent ecological reading without displacing the sovereign and judicial models.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive return can support ongoing routing and final compelled return; the packet does not force one temporal scope.
The ecological and institutional models depend on cross-domain branch activation and should remain qualified rather than treated as lexical translations.
